purpose: A local developer CLI that sends yes/no checks about files to the Jev API. A developer or an agent runs it by hand, so its arguments and files come from the developer, not from untrusted users.
rules: Go standard library and git only.
The API key is read from TYPESAFE_API_KEY in the environment, falling back to the local .env, and sent only to the Jev API.
Nothing in this folder points to files outside it.
This is a public GitHub repository, written in English. Jev, noul, and TypeSafe are the public names of the API and its yes/no answer type.

One Go binary, jev-check. ask.go lists and asks checks and embeds the bundled ones, context.go builds the project state and holds init, secrets.go scans patches and every outgoing request locally, judge.go applies thresholds, gate.go runs the checks on staged files, eval.go tests thresholds on fixtures. The *_test.go files test them offline with a fake Jev server, in temp folders, and passes paths like ../x to check that they are refused.
folders.input/questions: One check per file, built into the binary. example.json is the first check a new user runs.
folders.input/states: Optional fixed state per check. example.json holds a short script with two deliberate flaws for the example check to find.
folders..claude/skills/jev-check: Tells an agent how to use the tool.
folders..github/workflows: ci.yml runs gofmt, go vet, the offline tests, the build, and a few local commands on every pull request, with no secrets.
folders.CODING_STYLE.md: The coding rules for this repository's Go code, read by people and by the opt-in coding-style check.
folders.fixtures: Known pass and fail patches that set each check's threshold. Excluded from the gate.
